AC AMENDMENT (gap-analysis F5 cross-task collision with S4): Add precondition guard.
- [ ] Test precondition asserts version files are NOT in .test-index (so S5 bump cannot trigger S4 RED-test-blocker)
  Verify: ! grep -E '(^|/)(version|VERSION|pyproject\.toml|package\.json)(\s|$)' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- Test must fail loudly if a future change adds version files to .test-index
